title: ctrlyoke Prompt Schema
description: Schema for ctrlyoke workflows. Steps should be in final-form format with all context references (e.g., @path/to/file, @path/to/dir/, #selection:path:line-line, #sym.<kind>:path:symbol:line-line) included directly in the prompt text. ctrlyoke inserts the kinded #sym.<kind>: form; hand-authored #sym:path:symbol:line-line remains valid and generic. ctrlyoke expands these references into inline file/symbol content before sending to the AI.

finalStep.description: A step that always runs after all queued prompts complete. Can be an AI prompt or a script step. If mcpServers includes "ctrlyoke" and the finalStep appends prompts, those prompts run before finalStep executes again. Working files store resolved harness/model/session metadata on finalStep._runtime; workflow phase/status remains in the root _runtime.finalStep block.

originalFile.description: Path to original prompt file (working files only)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when workflow started (working files only)

vars.description: Workflow-level variable defaults for {{varName}} substitution in prompt text, model, additionalArgs, hook commands, and endCondition script paths. CLI --var key=value flags override these at runtime.

templatePlaceholder.description: A template variable placeholder such as {harness}. Only accepted in authoring files that declare _templateMeta.

templateMetadata.description: Authoring metadata for a reusable workflow template. Removed when the template is instantiated.

name.description: Display name shown in the template picker.

description.description: Short explanation shown in the template picker.

variables.description: Metadata for placeholders used by this template, keyed by variable name.

type.description: Control used to collect this variable in the template dialog.

fileFilter.description: File-picker glob patterns used by file variables.

options.description: Available values for a select variable.

autoFillFilename.description: Use the selected file or directory basename as the initial workflow name.

description.description: Help text shown below the variable control.

default.description: Initial value used when the user leaves the variable unchanged.

multiline.description: Render a text variable as a multiline input.

oneOf.description: Explicitly run this workflow in the ordinary workspace.
Named-worktree branch shorthand. The value must be a valid local Git branch name.
Managed creates a throw-away worktree and branch per run and removes the directory when the workflow completes, leaving the branch for review; pick it for isolated runs you will not follow up on.

merge.description: Merge the managed branch into the captured source checkout after the run.

keep.description: Keeps the managed worktree directory after the run instead of removing it. Without it, appending a follow-up prompt recreates the directory from the branch; ignored files such as node_modules are gone and the setup command runs again, so a long setup pays that cost on every append. Removing the directory also ends filesystem undo for that run.

base.description: Optional Git ref resolved to a commit when the worktree is created.

setup.description: Optional setup command run after a new managed worktree is created. Setup is outside the step-scoped errorBehavior policy: it runs before any step is in flight, so a non-succeeded setup blocks the worktree and the next Run re-runs it; a succeeded outcome is skipped.

oneOf.description: Named targets a persistent worktree you own, which ctrlyoke never commits, merges, or removes; pick it for conversational workflows you will append to.

branch.description: Local Git branch name for the named worktree.

base.description: Optional Git ref resolved to a commit when the worktree is created.

setup.description: Optional setup command run after a new named worktree is created. Setup is outside the step-scoped errorBehavior policy: it runs before any step is in flight, so a non-succeeded setup blocks the worktree and the next Run re-runs it; a succeeded outcome is skipped.

workflowOnlyProperties.description: Properties authored only at the workflow root.

rootScriptStep.description: A top-level script workflow with workflow-only properties.

workflowKey.description: Stable workflow lineage key within the current workspace.

executionProperties.description: Shared execution configuration properties used across workflow-level defaults, prompt-level overrides, and runtime metadata

harness.description: Harness to use for this prompt. Determines which AI CLI executes the prompt. Optional - defaults to ctrlyoke.harness setting.

model.description: AI model to use for this prompt. Use IntelliSense (Ctrl+Space) to see available models. Each harness supports different models — unsupported models fall back to the harness default with a warning. Use 'none' to skip the --model flag entirely (e.g. for custom Bedrock model strings passed via additionalArgs). Optional - defaults to the active harness model setting.

executionMode.description: Where this step runs. 'interactive' uses a live PTY/TUI; 'headless' runs in the background with output in the Output panel. Pre/end-condition scripts always run headless. Omitting this field inherits the workflow/global default.

oneOf.description: Empty string means no agent — the form the dashboard's "None" selection serializes to. Distinct from null, which explicitly disables an inherited agent.

agent.description: Portable ctrlyoke prompt attachment. Specify ONLY the agent name without file extensions (e.g., 'ctrlyoke-workflow-composer' for file 'ctrlyoke-workflow-composer.agent.md'). CliPromptPreparer.createCategorizedPromptFiles() resolves the content into prompt references and wraps agent content in <agentInstructions> tags. Native harness agent discovery is managed separately in the Agents & Skills settings page and does not determine workflow agent support. Use null to explicitly disable inherited agent selection.

resumeSession.description: Whether to resume the existing chat session for this prompt. When omitted, defaults to the ctrlyoke.resumeExistingSession setting (default: false). Set to true to continue in the existing session for context continuity. Retries continue in the same session by default; set endCondition.resumeSessionOnRetry=false to start a fresh session for each retry.

oneOf.description: A well-known MCP server ID (e.g., "ctrlyoke" to enable dynamic queue extension).
MCP servers to attach. Registry IDs resolve against ctrlyoke's managed MCP registry; include "ctrlyoke" to enable dynamic queue extension.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to attach to the harness for this prompt/workflow. Registry IDs resolve against ctrlyoke's managed MCP registry. Include "ctrlyoke" to enable dynamic queue extension via ctrlyoke's MCP server. Use /mcp:<server-id> in the prompt to force-attach a managed server; an inline reference wins over null, which otherwise explicitly disables inherited servers.

oneOf.description: User-defined hooks. Per-event override: events present replace the tier below for that event; absent events inherit.
Explicitly disables all hooks for this prompt/workflow.

hooks.description: User-defined hooks run alongside ctrlyoke's completion-detection hooks. Supported events vary by harness; unsupported events are silently skipped.

sessionId.description: Session ID for resuming CLI conversations. Can be: a string (exact CLI session ID to resume), a number (prompt reference: 1 = use session from first prompt), or the special value "finalStep" (resume the session established by the most recent final step execution — works on any prompt, not just the final step itself; on first pass when no final step session exists yet, a new session starts). When omitted and resumeSession=true, automatically resumes previous prompt's session. Working file runtime metadata stores the actual session ID used during execution.

skills.description: Portable ctrlyoke prompt attachments. CliPromptPreparer.createCategorizedPromptFiles() resolves the selected skill content into categorized prompt references. The Agents & Skills settings page separately manages optional harness-native discovery directories whose behavior varies by harness; native discovery does not determine workflow skills support. Prompt-level skills replace workflow-level skills (no merging). Use null to explicitly disable inherited skills.

endCondition.description: End condition validation to run after this prompt completes. Use null to explicitly disable end condition inheritance from the workflow level (even if the workflow defines one). Omitting this field inherits the workflow-level end condition (if any).

preCondition.description: Script gate that runs before the prompt. Determines whether to run the prompt, skip it, or stop the workflow. When set at workflow level, all prompts inherit it unless overridden. Use null to disable an inherited pre-condition for a specific prompt.

priorContext.description: Controls injection of prior prompt outputs into this prompt's text before sending to the AI. 'all' injects all prior outputs; 'previous' injects the immediately preceding output; 'none' disables injection; an array of integers ([1, 3]) injects specific prompts by 1-based index; or { workflowKey, runRef } imports the complete terminal output from one run in this workspace. Addresses never contain local paths. When omitted, no context is injected. Note: combining with resumeSession:true may duplicate context (accepted limitation).

oneOf.description: Keyword shorthand: 'all' = all prior queue prompt outputs, 'previous' = immediately preceding queue prompt output, 'none' = no injection, 'finalStepAll' = all previous final step loop outputs, 'finalStepPrevious' = immediately preceding final step loop output
Specific prior prompt numbers to include (1-based, e.g. [1, 3] includes prompts 1 and 3)
Import all resolved queue and final-step output from one completed run in this same workspace.

additionalArgs.description: Additional CLI flags appended to ctrlyoke's standard argument set. ctrlyoke continues to manage model, permissions, workspace dirs, and session flags normally. Tokens are injected before the tool permission args. Applies to all harnesses (copilot-cli, claude-cli, codex-cli, opencode-cli, qwen-cli, antigravity-cli). Use null at prompt level to explicitly disable additional args even if the workflow or settings define some. Example: "--effort high --max-turns 10"

oneOf.description: Per-workflow/prompt tool permission overrides. Follows three-tier precedence: prompt > workflow > global VS Code settings. Only applies to CLI harnesses.

mode.description: Permission mode. 'dangerouslyAllowAll' bypasses all restrictions. 'allowAll' auto-grants all but respects deny list. 'custom' uses allowedTools + deniedTools only. 'passthrough' omits all ctrlyoke permission flags — the harness uses whatever permissions the user has configured in its own local settings (e.g. ~/.claude/settings.json, Copilot CLI config).

allowedTools.description: Tool patterns to allow (used in custom mode). Currently supported by Copilot CLI, Claude CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode. Qwen uses inline granular support. OpenCode delivers permissions through OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT and writes no workspace opencode.json. Codex and Antigravity provide a derived mode-only summary; Allowed Tools are NOT ENFORCED by those harnesses.

deniedTools.description: Tool patterns to deny (takes precedence over allow list). Currently supported by Copilot CLI, Claude CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode. Qwen uses inline granular support. OpenCode delivers permissions through OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT and writes no workspace opencode.json. Codex and Antigravity provide a derived mode-only summary; Denied Tools are NOT ENFORCED by those harnesses.

toolPermissions.description: Tool permission overrides for this prompt/workflow. Use null to explicitly disable inherited overrides and fall back to global VS Code settings. Set mode to 'passthrough' to omit all ctrlyoke permission flags and rely entirely on the harness's own local configuration.

errorBehavior.description: Internal-error policy for every step phase: pre-conditions, prompts/harnesses, end-conditions, and script steps. Worktree setup is outside this policy: errorBehavior is step-scoped (EXECUTION_PROPERTY_KEYS) and resolves through the prompt → workflow → settings chain, but setup runs before any step is in flight, so it has no resolution context; a non-succeeded setup blocks the worktree and the next Run is the recovery gesture. Use null to explicitly disable an inherited policy.

type.description: Optional step type discriminator. When omitted, the step is treated as an AI prompt (backwards compatible).

name.description: Optional human-readable display label shown in the ctrlyoke dashboard. If omitted, the dashboard shows a truncated preview of the prompt text.

enabled.description: Whether this step executes. When omitted, the step is enabled. Set to false to keep the step in the workflow but skip execution.

prompt.description: The prompt text to send to the AI. Can be either: (1) Final-form prompt text with context references expanded inline before sending — use @path/to/file or @path/to/dir/ for files/directories, and #selection:path:line-line or #sym.<kind>:path:symbol:line-line for file excerpts and symbols. ctrlyoke inserts the kinded #sym.<kind>: form; hand-authored #sym:path:symbol:line-line remains valid and generic. OR (2) A file path to a .prompt.md, .md, or .txt file containing the prompt. File paths are resolved relative to the prompt file's directory, then workspace root, then .ctrlyoke directory. Absolute paths are also supported.

_runtime.description: Per-prompt runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

scriptStep.description: A workflow step that runs a shell script/command with no AI interaction.

enabled.description: Whether this step executes. When omitted, the step is enabled. Set to false to keep the step in the workflow but skip execution.

executionMode.description: Where this script step runs. 'interactive' uses a live PTY/TUI; 'headless' runs in the background with output in the Output panel. Omitting this field inherits the global default.

script.description: Shell command or path to script. Resolved relative to workspace root or .ctrlyoke/.

compareSource.description: Which output to compare against returns. 'auto' (default): 'true'/'false' use exit code, other values compare stdout. 'stdout': always compare stdout. 'stderr': compare stderr content. 'exitCode': compare the numeric exit code directly.

returns.description: Expected result to compare against. When absent, exit code 0 = pass. Interpretation depends on compareSource (default auto): for 'true'/'false' uses exit code; for other values checks stdout.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to ctrlyoke.scriptTimeout setting.

errorBehavior.description: Internal-error policy for this script step when it cannot run or evaluation breaks. Use null to explicitly disable an inherited workflow policy.

onPass.description: What to do when the script passes (exit 0 / returns matches). 'continue': advance the queue (default). 'stopWorkflow': halt execution immediately.

onFail.description: What to do when the script fails or returns is not matched. 'continue': log a warning and advance the queue. 'stopWorkflow': halt execution (default).

_runtime.description: Per-step runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

script.description: Path to script file to execute, or direct shell command (e.g., 'npm test', 'python script.py'). File paths are resolved relative to workspace root or .ctrlyoke directory.

returns.description: Expected result to compare against. Interpretation depends on compareSource (default auto): for 'true'/'false' auto uses exit code (exit 0 = true, non-zero = false); for other values auto checks stdout via exact match, numeric >=, or substring. For compareSource: exitCode, provide the expected exit code as a number string (e.g., '0', '1') or 'true'/'false'.

compareSource.description: Which output to compare against `returns`. 'auto' (default): 'true'/'false' use exit code, other values compare stdout. 'stdout': always compare stdout (also requires clean exit). 'stderr': compare stderr content (exit code ignored). 'exitCode': compare the numeric exit code directly.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to ctrlyoke.scriptTimeout setting.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when validation fails. Use -1 for unlimited retries (use with caution), 0 for no retries (default), or 1-100 for a specific limit.

retryPrompt.description: Template for retry prompt with placeholders: {stdout}, {stderr}, {exitCode}, {actual}, {expected}, {compareSource}

passRetryPrompt.description: Template for pass-retry prompt with placeholders: {stdout}, {stderr}, {exitCode}, {actual}, {expected}, {compareSource}. If omitted, the step's own prompt is re-sent.

resumeSessionOnRetry.description: Whether retries continue in the same session. Default: true (retries resume the existing session for context continuity). Set to false to start a fresh session for each retry.

onPass.description: What to do when the end condition passes. 'continue': advance to the next step (default). 'retry': re-run the step's prompt while the condition keeps passing, up to maxRetries; exhausting the retries advances to the next step. A failure during the loop is handled by onFail. 'stopWorkflow': halt execution immediately.

onFail.description: What to do when end condition fails. 'retry': re-run the AI prompt (up to maxRetries times). 'continue': advance to the next step even if validation fails. 'stopWorkflow': halt execution (default). When 'retry' is set and maxRetries is unset, defaults to 1 retry.

scriptProperties.description: Shared script execution properties used by endCondition, preCondition, and scriptStep.

script.description: Shell command or path to script. Resolved relative to workspace root or .ctrlyoke/.

compareSource.description: Which output to compare against returns. 'auto' (default): 'true'/'false' use exit code, other values compare stdout. 'stdout': always compare stdout. 'stderr': compare stderr content. 'exitCode': compare the numeric exit code directly.

returns.description: Expected result to compare against. When absent, exit code 0 = pass.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to ctrlyoke.scriptTimeout setting.

preCondition.description: Script gate that runs before the prompt. Determines whether to run the prompt, skip it, or stop the workflow.

onPass.description: What to do when the pre-condition check passes (script exits 0 / returns matches). 'continue': run the prompt (default). 'skipPrompt': skip this prompt and advance the queue. 'stopWorkflow': halt execution.

onFail.description: What to do when the pre-condition check fails. 'continue': run the prompt anyway (pre-condition is advisory). 'skipPrompt': skip this prompt and advance the queue (default). 'stopWorkflow': halt execution.

errorBehavior.description: Policy for internal errors in any step phase, including pre-conditions, prompts/harnesses, end-conditions, and script steps. Worktree setup is outside this policy: errorBehavior is step-scoped (EXECUTION_PROPERTY_KEYS) and resolves through the prompt → workflow → settings chain, but setup runs before any step is in flight, so it has no resolution context; a non-succeeded setup blocks the worktree and the next Run is the recovery gesture.

onError.description: What to do when a step phase cannot run or otherwise encounters an internal error.

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts when onError is retry.

promptRuntimeMetadata.description: Per-prompt runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when this prompt started execution

completedAt.description: Timestamp when this prompt completed execution (set for all terminal states, not just successful completion)

terminalStatus.description: Terminal state of this prompt. Absent or 'completed' means successful completion. Used to restore the correct visual status after a working file reload.

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts for this prompt

failureKind.description: Structured classification of the last harness/session failure for this prompt.

failureMessage.description: Human-readable message describing the last harness/session failure.

runtimeMetadata.description: Workflow-level runtime execution state for working files (optional, added automatically by ctrlyoke during execution)

startTime.description: Wall-clock timestamp when active workflow execution timing began

pausedTime.description: Wall-clock timestamp when the current pause began

totalPausedDuration.description: Accumulated time spent paused before the current pause, in milliseconds

executionEndTime.description: Wall-clock timestamp when workflow execution reached a terminal state

tokenTotals.description: Latest run-scoped token aggregate projected from timeline history (working files only, written automatically during execution)

pendingRewind.description: Durable marker for an in-place, nonzero rewind. The full pre-rewind file is kept beside the run until the continuation is committed or discarded.

fromStepIndex.description: 0-based index of the first rewound step

baseDefinitionRevision.description: Definition revision the rewind was taken from

finalStep.description: Runtime metadata for final step execution state (optional, added automatically during execution)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when final step execution started

completedAt.description: Timestamp when final step execution completed

preCondition.description: Latest pre-condition evaluation retained for the final step's automation result projection

endCondition.description: Latest end-condition evaluation retained for the final step's automation result projection

conditionEvaluationSummary.description: Latest script-condition evaluation retained for the automation result projection (written automatically during execution).

action.description: Populated for pre-conditions, where it explains the gate decision.

harnessTokenTotals.description: Per-harness token subtotal within a run aggregate.

workflowTokenTotals.description: Run-scoped token aggregate projected from timeline history. Written automatically during execution; not hand-authored.

total.description: Sum of every AI attempt's token total observed in this run

coverage.description: 'complete' only when every executed AI attempt reported a usable total

isFinal.description: False while the run can still add usage

byHarness.description: Same aggregate partitioned by the harness recorded on each immutable attempt output.

byLocalDay.description: Same per-harness subtotals partitioned by the attempt start's local day (YYYY-MM-DD).

event.description: Logical hook event. Unsupported events for the active harness are silently skipped. 'stop' maps to Stop (Claude/Qwen/Antigravity), agentStop (Copilot), notify (Codex).

command.description: Command to execute. Resolved relative to workspace root if not absolute.

timeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds. Only respected by CLIs that support per-hook timeouts.

mcpServerConfig.description: User-defined MCP server configuration. Exactly one of `command` (stdio) or `url` (remote) must be set.

command.description: Command to run the MCP server process (stdio servers, e.g. "npx" or "node")

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command (stdio servers only)

env.description: Environment variables for the server process (stdio servers only)

autoApprove.description: Tools to auto-approve: true = all tools, string[] = specific tools

url.description: Remote endpoint URL for streamable-http or SSE servers (e.g. "https://mcp.example.com")

transport.description: Transport protocol for remote servers. Defaults to "streamable-http".

headers.description: HTTP headers to send with every request (remote servers only, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer token" })
